ageContext.bookAge: 12 to 18 months in the home chart; 18+ months in the appendix, with earlier activities continuing into later ages.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in pouring; a manageable small jug, a little liquid, and help for spills.

ageContext.bookAge: 12 months in the appendix; from 12 months in the illustrated example.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in marks; chunky materials that glide easily, with room for the child’s own lines.

ageContext.bookAge: Fetching shoes appears at 12 to 18 months; the chart adds other activities at 18 months to 3 years.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in fetching or returning shoes; reachable storage and a seat support participation.

ageContext.bookAge: The appendix begins knobbed puzzles at 12–14+ months; the chapter adds difficulty from about 18 months.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in removing or fitting pieces; the challenge can be simplified and the adult can help.

ageContext.bookAge: Related appendix examples have different starting ages: rings and opening/closing at 12+ months; posting and box variants at 14+ months.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in fitting or turning; simplify what is offered and retain small-part supervision.

ageContext.bookAge: Around 18 months in the chapter; 18+ months in the appendix; sorting small buttons is illustrated from 2 years.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in likenesses, types, colors, or sizes; supervised small objects and ordinary clothing are distinct examples.

ageContext.bookAge: All ages in the appendix, in the book’s toddler context.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in a song, rhythm, movement, or listening together.

ageContext.bookAge: All ages in the appendix; the chapter distinguishes short wording for younger toddlers and longer sentences and rhymes for older toddlers.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in familiar books and pictures; choose by the child’s interest and handling of pages.

ageContext.bookAge: All ages in the appendix; sounds, phrases, and sentences are different forms of participation.
ageContext.readiness: The child wants to share through sounds, gestures, or speech; wait and listen without finishing for them.

ageContext.bookAge: Vocabulary objects 12+ months, matching cards 14+ months, vocabulary cards 18+ months in the appendix. The formal naming test is for over 3.
ageContext.readiness: Name familiar things; identical matching precedes similar matching; follow the child’s interest without a test.

ageContext.bookAge: Chalk at 12 months; easel painting requires standing unaided; watercolor is 18+ months in the appendix.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in marks; easel painting retains standing unaided, and painting is supervised.

ageContext.bookAge: Gluing from around 18 months in the chapter; clay is around 16 to 18+ months in the appendix.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in pressing, applying glue, rolling, or manipulating material; supervise small parts and sharp tools.

ageContext.bookAge: Toddler-wide discussion; no fixed age for noticing outdoors.
ageContext.readiness: Pausing, pointing, listening, or looking at an outdoor detail; share the child’s pace.

ageContext.bookAge: Toddler-wide movement discussion; specific equipment examples carry differing ages and support.
ageContext.readiness: Choose from the movements the child is seeking rather than treating the whole list as skills to do.
ageContext.note: The entry gives a broad movement perspective; it does not prescribe the book’s full equipment list at this age.

ageContext.bookAge: Dusting and sweeping at 16–18+ months in the appendix; the home chart continues them at 18 months to 3 years.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in wiping or copying household work; keep help and cleaning tools manageable.

ageContext.bookAge: The chapter gives an 18-month-old carrying a T-shirt; sorting appears at 18 months to 3 years; hanging cloths is 18+ months in the appendix.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in carrying clothing, sorting socks or colors, or using pegs with supervision; participation may stay small.
ageContext.note: Carrying and sorting remain useful here. The separate 3+ folding row does not make folding part of this entry.

ageContext.bookAge: Watering is 14+ months with steady walking; flower arranging and germinating seeds are 18+ months in the appendix.
ageContext.readiness: Steady walking for the watering example; interest in plant care or part of arranging flowers; cut stems and supervision retained.

ageContext.bookAge: The home chart includes food preparation at 18 months to 3 years, with help; sharp knives remain out of reach and the preschool knife example is later.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in contributing with adult help; food preparation remains supervised.
ageContext.note: The body preserves separate tool and age descriptions; this age does not authorize all listed cutting tasks.

ageContext.bookAge: Setting and clearing the table at 18 months to 3 years in the home chart; 18+ months in the appendix.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in carrying something to or from the table; help and a manageable item or basket.

ageContext.bookAge: Toddler-wide home guidance; no numerical age for arranging, rotating, or returning activities.
ageContext.readiness: Choose from current interests; put aside incomplete or too-difficult activities, and share returning them.

ageContext.bookAge: The home discussion covers siblings of different ages; it gives no fixed age for a shared-space arrangement.
ageContext.readiness: Shared belongings, privacy, and younger children reaching older children’s small parts.

ageContext.bookAge: Toddler art trays; independent gathering of a full set of materials appears around 3 years.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in making art; materials and places for wet or saved work help the activity begin and end.
ageContext.note: The around-3 example is later context within this broad band, not an expectation for a newly two-year-old.

ageContext.bookAge: Home play is unaged within the toddler chapter; the separate creativity discussion places pretend play around 2.5+ years.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in open-ended familiar toys; later pretend play can draw on real daily experience.
ageContext.note: The start of this band does not imply pretend play should have begun; Davies’s later description remains around 2½ and older.

ageContext.bookAge: Shopping participation is a practical-life example; the home chart includes it at 18 months to 3 years.
ageContext.readiness: Interest in a real part of shopping, such as a picture list or passing an item; adult help and time remain available.
